intro.title: When it goes wrong
intro.body:
The course has taught you the calm world — the weather, the doctor, the timetable. These twelve words are for the day that goes wrong, and every news bulletin in English is built from them.
The first six are the event itself and the seconds before it: what happened, what it ruined, and who walked away. The last six are the older kind of trouble — someone on the other side, and what that does to you.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: damage, survive, frighten, hurry and shoot are verbs; the rest are nouns. Two pairs are easy to collapse: horror is the feeling and a battle is the event, and damage is what a storm does, while an explosion is a thing that happens.
intro.note_cz: damage, survive, frighten, hurry, shoot jsou slovesa. Pozor: horror je ten pocit, ne ta událost.
